tasks.subject: Remove global mutable config from row painting
tasks.description: row.ts has a module-level `fallbackConfig` + `useConfig()` and four functions taking `config = defaultConfig()`. That is hidden mutable state: painting silently depends on load order, and one test can leak config into the next. Replace with a Painter that binds theme+config once per render, so every paint call is explicit and row.ts has no globals.

tasks.subject: Split the 424-line config.ts by concern
tasks.description: config.ts mixes three concerns: (1) schema/defaults/Config class, (2) settings.json disk I/O including comment handling, (3) legacy pi-minimalist.json migration. Split into config.ts (schema + Config) and config-file.ts (paths, load, save, migration).

tasks.subject: Rename QuietMode to RunGrouping and drop compat shims
tasks.description: There is no /quiet command anymore and the setting is `groupToolRuns`, so QuietMode/QuietView/QuietOutcome are stale names. Rename to RunGrouping/RowView/Outcome (file run-grouping.ts) and rename the bridge symbols to match. Drop the `Config | boolean` constructor shim that exists only for tests — give tests a real config helper instead. Remove the dead GUTTER_WIDTH back-compat export.

tasks.subject: Replace positional params with named options
tasks.description: summaryRow(theme, done, failed, running, config) has three same-typed array params in a row — easy to transpose silently. Introduce a shared RunSummary type and pass it as one object. Same for installBridges(quiet, timers, config).

tasks.subject: Rewrite AGENTS.md around the current design
tasks.description: 519 lines accumulated by incremental agent edits: stale /quiet references, a Files table that no longer matches src/, and history mixed into reference material. Restructure so it answers what a future reader needs: what it does, how it hooks into Pi, the invariants that must not be "fixed", and how to validate. Keep every hard-won gotcha but attach it to the code it protects.
